title: Ɛnne a Ɛyɛ Komm a Ɛwɔ Pia no Mu
intro: Mpaebɔ bi gyegyeegye wɔ dan kronkron bi mu kommyɛ mu bere tenten a atwam ni, na ɛsɔre fii ɔkra a ne mfe akɔ anim a na n’ani bere nea wiase no aka sɛ entumi nyɛ yiye no mu. Saa onipa yi a na wanyin mfe pii na daakye ho dadwen ayɛ no adesoa no de n’ankasa nkotɔsrɛ dan kɔɔ wɔn Awurade nkyɛn. Nea edii akyi bae ne ɔsoro mmuae a ɛtia abɔde mu akwanhwɛ biara —Nea obua ɔfrɛ a ɛyɛ basaa no mmɔborohunu ho adanse.
clues: Mefrɛɛ m’Awurade wɔ kokoam, na metwee me ho kɔɔ dan bi a mede me ho hyɛɛ mu maa Ne som.
Megye toom kyerɛɛ m’Awurade sɛ mesuro ma wɔn a wɔbɛba m’akyi, a na mehaw me ho wɔ me nkurɔfoɔ akwankyerɛ ho berɛ a mafiri hɔ no.
Ná mpanyinyɛ atwa me —na me nnompe ayɛ mmerɛw na na ti nhwi fitaa atrɛw wɔ me ti so.
Ná me hokafo ayɛ obonin n’asetra nyinaa, nanso na meda so ara srɛ m’Awurade sɛ ɔmma me ɔdedifo mfi N’ankasa anim.
Mesrɛɛ sɛnkyerɛnne, na m’Awurade buae denam kwan a osiw me kwan sɛ menkasa nkyerɛ obiara anadwo abiɛsa, bere a mekɔɔ so yɛɛ honam fam ahoɔden no so.
Wɔhyɛɛ me bɔ sɛ ɔbɛma me ɔbabarima a ne din bɛyɛ Yahya, edin a m’Awurade paee mu kae sɛ wɔmfaa mmaa obiara da.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
